record.auth_notes: Basic auth with an API ID and API token generated under Integrations > API keys in the Aircall dashboard (for own/private integrations). OAuth 2.0 install flow for apps acting on behalf of other customers; the install must be completed by an Aircall Admin and yields a permanent access_token.
record.access_notes: Dashboard API keys are generated in-app, but the docs say direct Messaging API use needs the Professional plan; integrations can call it on any plan. The pricing page did not clearly show which tier includes the general API, so plan-level detail is unconfirmed.
record.api_notes: REST style inferred from the Public API docs with HTTP auth; breadth not fully verified. Webhooks are documented separately. Messaging API documented; access gated by plan.
record.blocker_notes: Direct API access (including Messaging API) requires the Professional plan, and the Aircall MCP is a read-only beta available by contacting an Account Manager.
